bibl.title: Birds, Beasts, and a Unicorn at Oxyrhynchus.
bibl.seg: Helen Whitehouse, Birds, Beasts, and a Unicorn at Oxyrhynchus.

Gianfranco Adornato (ed.), Intorno al Papiro di Artemidoro. III. I disegni. Atti del Convegno internazionale del 4 febbraio 2011 presso il Gabinetto Disegni e Stampe degli Uffizi, Firenze (Milano, 2016) pp. 105-127, figg.
bibl.note: Discusses two animal drawings soon to be published in P. Oxy. LXXXIII: P. Oxy. Inv. 82/28(a): male caprid in profile, leaping to the right, executed with pen and black ink; - P. Oxy. Inv. 25 3B/58J(a) [ii]: seven depictions of birds and animals - including an elegant unicorn -, executed on both sides with both thick and thin strokes of the pen in brown ink.
